The [[Dreadspawn Maw]] is a colossal demon who is the mother of the [[Stygian]]s and one of the four [[Lords of Anguish]]. It seems to have merged into the land itself, leaving the only visible portions of her body consisting of a large fanged maw surrounded by tentacles and fanged trenches known as spawning tunnels.

Unlike other [[Mallyx the Unyielding]]'s Overseers, it cannot be fought directly, but is slain by destroying its [[Smothering Tendrils]] and all the Stygian creatures which spawn after a Tendril is killed.
